title: Integrals pulled back along a bi-Lipschitz piece (supplied step 10)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P L-Lipschitz, A ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel and m > 0 with m|a − a'| ≤ |G(a) − G(a')| for all a, a' ∈ A. Let Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^P and λ := volume (Lebesgue measure) on ℝⁿ = Euclid n. Then for every Borel f : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], ∫_A f(G(u)) dλ(u) ≤ ofReal((m^n)^{-1})·∫_{G(A)} f dHⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet A → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable f → ∫⁻ u in A, f (G u) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((m ^ n)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ x in G '' A, f x ∂μHE[n]
